title: Adic evaluation of completed monoid algebras and congruence of evaluations
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\mathfrak a$ a finitely generated ideal of $R$. Let $P$ be a finitely generated commutative additive monoid which is sharp, meaning that its only invertible element is $0$. Write $R[P]=\bigoplus_{p\in P}Rz^p$, with $z^pz^q=z^{p+q}$, put $\mathfrak b=(\mathfrak a,z^p:p\ne0)$, and put $B=\varprojlim_n R[P]/\mathfrak b^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $J$ an ideal, and suppose that $A$ is $J$-adically complete and separated [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $\alpha:R\to A$ be a ring homomorphism with $\alpha(\mathfrak a)\subseteq J$. For every homomorphism $a:(P,+)\to(A,\cdot)$ with $a(0)=1$ and $a(p)\in J$ for $p\ne0$, there is a unique continuous ring homomorphism $E_a:B\to A$ which restricts to $\alpha$ on $R$ and sends $z^p$ to $a(p)$. It satisfies $E_a(\mathfrak b^nB)\subseteq J^n$ for every $n\ge0$. If $a,b$ are two such monoid homomorphisms, $p_1,\ldots,p_h$ are nonzero generators of $P$, and $a(p_i)-b(p_i)\in J^r$ for every $i$, where $r\ge1$, then $E_a(f)-E_b(f)\in J^r$ for every $f\in B$.

source.place: Tag 05GG, lemma-hathat-finitely-generated, finite-level completion kernels; agent-supplied monoid evaluation and congruence refinement of this inverse-limit construction, for ILO VI 2.3.
